issues: Sales were down on the previous week.
The Deliveroo rating is below the level needed to unlock additional platform features, and the team is working to improve it.
Deep cleaning was required to deal with a fruit fly problem, which involved setting off smoke bombs.
The deep cleaning routine has been split across Wednesday and Sunday so that standards can be maintained without needing two hours of continuous labour.
Assistant general manager trials are under way with a candidate named Dave, who comes from Wagamama, and the management training checklist needs to be completed with him.

Following a visit from Teddy, concerns were raised about the capability of the assistant head chef, Tom, an action plan is being created for him, and the sushi manager is being trained to take on a more senior kitchen role to support Rio.

The site is preparing for a Maki after dark promotion, Halloween activities and a local boat race, with drone footage planned for the race, high foot traffic expected on the Sunday and all sushi chefs arranged to be on duty.
A two metre gazebo is needed to give staff cover at outdoor promotional events, at a cost of around 50 pounds from B and Q, and this has been approved.

Region-wide (South England): The brand weekly average review rating is trending below target and needs to improve, as a single negative review can drag the average down despite many positive ones, so consistent cleaning and service standards are needed across the region.
Region-wide (South England): A memo on the correct use of discount buttons is being issued and needs to be checked by the group for accuracy so that discounts are recorded and tracked correctly.

Region-wide (South England): Google reviews are missing from the KPI sheet and need to be added, filed region-wide because Nikki, who was given the action, could not be resolved to a site from the transcript.
